verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only human-facing online filing through a browser-based web application, plus print-and-mail forms. Nothing describes a system-to-system channel such as an API, system accounts, transmitter or batch-provider programs, or any published enrollment path for software filers. The 'Prepaid Sunbiz E-File Account' is a payment option, which is an adjacent feature and not a machine channel, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
